Worldwide Grand Release on October 30th, 2026.

#AadarshaKutumbamHouseNo47 – #AK47 is an upcoming Telugu feature film starring Victory Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty, Nara Rohith, Nivetha Pethuraj, Yuvina Parthavi, Raja Prajwal and an ensemble cast.

Written and Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the film features music composed by S. Thaman, cinematography by Ravi K. Chandran, and editing by Navin Nooli.

Produced by S. Radha Krishna (Chinababu) under Haarika & Hassine Creations banner.

trending_videos.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
trending_videos.description:
Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida — forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive.

Check out the new Launch Trailer, featuring new music from electronic duo Justice, composers of the original score from Grand Theft Auto VI. 

The new standalone Justice single, “Flower in a Hurricane” feat. Tame Impala, SZA, and King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard, is also available on Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, the official soundtrack which is currently available to pre-save on all major music streaming services and up for pre-order on vinyl or CD.

Grand Theft Auto VI arrives November 19.
